create_lvis_evaluator: create an LVISEvaluator instance to evaluate object detection and segmentation outputs on LVIS datasets
run_lvis_evaluation: run LVIS AP evaluation on bbox or segm predictions and return per-category metrics like AP, AP50, APs, APm, APl
test_evaluate_box_proposals: test box proposal recall evaluation with configurable IoU thresholds and area ranges on LVIS annotations
summarize_lvis_predictions: summarize LVIS model predictions by processing inputs and outputs into LVIS-format result dictionaries
review_lvis_evaluator_reset: review the LVISEvaluator reset method to clear accumulated predictions before a new evaluation run
